title: Pricing boundary realignment — operational checklist and launch coordination
creator: Sofia Patel
description: Coordination ticket for the planned pricing boundary realignment: re-banding SKUs, adjusting quota/limit boundaries, and associated billing communication and sales enablement. This ticket owns the cross-team orchestration, final validation checklist, and go/no-go gating for the public rollout. Key outcomes: updated entitlement mapping, billing system verification, console display changes, release notes, and enablement materials for sales and support.
acceptance_criteria: Entitlement mapping table published and signed off by Finance and Legal
Billing simulation runs completed for top-10 customer usage profiles with no invoice regressions
Console SKU and limit UI updated and smoke-tested in staging
Release notes drafted, approved by PM and Legal, and ready for publishing
Sales enablement package (FAQ, customer decision tree, migration scripts) delivered and reviewed
Monitoring dashboards created for post-launch variance and quota anomalies
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (Prep): finalize mapping, mark migration windows, and freeze related PRs - target 2025-03-01
Phase 1 (Staged): apply new boundaries to 10% of accounts (non-enterprise) for 48 hours - target 2025-03-07
Phase 2 (Wider): expand to 50% with billing verification after 72 hours - target 2025-03-09
Phase 3 (Full): flip for remaining accounts with monitoring on 15-minute cadence - target 2025-03-14
Post-launch: 30-day verification window with daily runbook checks and weekly summary to execs
comms_plan: Pre-launch (2 weeks): email to affected customers with migration guidance and support contacts
Launch day: release notes published in Console + Help Center article; in-product banner for affected users
Sales: 1-hour live walkthrough and a short recorded video; updated battlecards
Support: canned responses, triage playbook, and escalation path to Billing Eng
Post-launch (7 days): targeted follow-up to customers with anomalous billing or quota behavior
tasks: Create entitlement mapping spreadsheet and owner sign-off - https://drive.redwood/example-entitlement-mapping (Sofia)
Implement billing rule changes and run staged simulation job (ENG-1842) - (Marcus)

Prepare sales enablement slides, FAQ, and migration decision tree - (Diego)
Create monitoring dashboards: billing-diffs, quota-violations, customer-reports - (Zhao)
Run end-to-end billing smoke tests for top-10 customers and archive results - (Tom)
Prepare support runbook and escalation matrix - (Emma)
Coordinate cutover window and mute rules with SRE - (Marcus)
Legal checklist: notices, TOS implications, and required opt-outs - (Priya)
rollback_plan: Immediate rollback trigger if >2% of active users see invoice delta >5% in staged cohort
Revert billing rule change in control plane (versioned) and reapply previous mapping
Notify impacted customers and open dedicated support channel
Create retrospective ticket to address root cause and re-run simulations prior to reattempt
monitoring_and_quality_checks: Pre-launch: run nightly billing simulation for 7 days and compare to baseline
During staged rollout: 15-minute job to surface invoice deltas per account and percent change
Post-launch: daily telemetry on average spend per customer, quota churn, and support contacts
Automated alerting thresholds: invoice-delta > 3% for accounts > $500/month, quota-errors > 0.5%
